items.title: 13.6 Stellar evolution (sitaron ki zindagi ka safar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.6, stellar evolution (PDF 12-15).

blocks.text: Jab kinetic theory of gases ko stars (sitaron) aur galaxies jaise astrophysical (khala ke) systems par lagaya jaye to yeh galaxy mein stars ki evolution (waqt ke saath badalna) aur star ke atmosphere ke gas atoms ko samajhne mein madad deti hai.

Stellar evolution yeh parhta hai ke star waqt ke saath kaise badalta hai. Stars ki life (umar) chand million saal se le kar trillions saal tak hoti hai, aur star ki umar us ke mass par depend karti hai. Sab se kam mass wale stars (red dwarfs) ki umar sab se lambi hai, universe (kainat) ki maujooda umar se bhi zyada. Saare stars gas aur dust (gard) ke badalon se bante hain jinhein nebulae ya molecular clouds kehte hain; contract hota hua (sukarta hua) badal proto-star kehlata hai. Badal contract hota hai to particles ki K.E. barhti hai, is liye density aur temperature barhte hain (K.E. ∝ T). Millions saal baad proto-star equilibrium (balance) hasil kar ke star ban jata hai. Density barhne se star ki gases ki rms velocity barhti hai; is se average kinetic energy aur aakhir mein temperature waqt ke saath barhta hai. Figure 13.4 gravity aur pressure ka muqabla dikhati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke 'sab se bhari stars ki umar lambi hoti hai'. Haqeeqat ulat hai: bhari stars apna fuel (eendhan) bohat tezi se jalate hain aur sirf chand million saal jeete hain, jab ke sab se halke stars (red dwarfs) trillions saal, universe ki maujooda umar se bhi zyada, jeete hain. Kitab khud aage chal kar red dwarfs ke bare mein yahi kehti hai.

blocks.alt: Teen gole. Baen: gole ke andar pink arrows (self-gravity) andar ki taraf aur bahar blue arrows (gas pressure) bahar ki taraf. Beech aur daen: gas ka badal jis ke chaaron taraf ek blue gravity arrow andar aur ek pink pressure arrow bahar hai; daen badal ke particles beech wale se kahin zyada qareeb qareeb hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.4: Gravity ka andar dabana bahar ki taraf pressure se balance hota hai. Zyada gravity gas ko daba kar zyada dense (ghana) aur garam karti hai (kitab ki Figure 13.4 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Temperature barhne se andar ka pressure bhi barhta hai. Stable (mazboot, qaim rehne wala) star tab banta hai jab andar ki taraf kheenchne wali gravitational force bahar ki taraf dhakelne wale pressure ke bilkul barabar ho. Is condition (shart) ko hydrostatic equation bayan karti hai:
Yeh equation yaqeeni banati hai ke star na gravity se collapse ho (andar gir jaye) aur na be-hisaab phailta jaye.

Yahan P star ke andar pressure (unit area par force) hai, ΔP/Δr radius ke saath pressure badalne ka rate (centre se bahar ki taraf pressure kaise badalta hai), r star ke centre se distance, G gravitational constant (6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²), M_r radius r ke andar ka mass aur ρ_r radius r par density hai. Minus ka nishan batata hai ke pressure bahar ki taraf kam hota hai jab ke gravity andar kheenchti hai. Agar pressure aur gravity ka balance na rahe to do possibilities (suratein) hain:

items: Gravitational force > andar ka pressure: star contract hota hai (sukarta hai) aur garam hota hai.
Gravitational force < andar ka pressure: star expand hota hai (phailta hai).

blocks.text: Jab star ke core (andar ka hissa) ka temperature barhta hai to nuclear fusion shuru hota hai: hydrogen ke nuclei jur kar helium banate hain. Is se bohat zyada energy nikalti hai jo star ko us ki zyada tar zindagi chalati hai. Lagatar energy banna sirf gravity se girne ke khilaf balance hi nahi rakhta, andar ka temperature bhi ahista ahista barhata hai; result yeh ke star phailna shuru karta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Parsec distance ki unit hai jo astronomers (sitaron ke scientists) light-year ki jagah istemal karte hain, jaise miles ki jagah kilometres. Ek parsec taqreeban 3.26 light years, ya taqreeban 19 trillion miles (31 trillion km) hai.

Temperature aur barhne aur core ki composition (banawat) badalne se star bohat phail kar red giant ban sakta hai. Is stage par jin stars ka mass kam az kam Sun (Sooraj) ke aadhe mass ke barabar ho, un ke core mein helium fusion shuru ho sakta hai, jis se carbon aur oxygen jaise bhari elements bante hain. Zyada bhari stars mein yeh silsila stage by stage aur bhari elements tak, iron tak, chalta hai.

Star ka final fate (aakhri anjam) zyada tar us ke mass par depend karta hai. Nuclear fuel khatam hone par star gravity ke khilaf khud ko nahi sambhal sakta. Kam aur darmiyane mass wale stars ka core contract ho kar dense white dwarf banta hai aur bahar ki layers (tahein) space (khala) mein phenk di jati hain, jo planetary nebula banati hain. Sun se taqreeban das guna zyada mass wale stars zabardast supernova explosion (dhamake) se guzarte hain; is mein iron ka core gravity se gir kar neutron star ya black hole jaisi bohat dense remnants (bachi hui cheezein) banata hai.

Red dwarf stars kam mass aur fuel ko bohat kifayat se (bachat se) istemal karne ki wajah se bohat ahista badalte hain. Universe abhi itna purana nahi ke koi red dwarf apni zindagi poori kar chuka ho. Theory ke models batate hain ke yeh stars waqt ke saath ahista ahista zyada garam aur roshan honge, phir hydrogen fuel khatam kar ke kam mass wale white dwarfs ban jayenge.

blocks.alt: Branches (shaakhon) wala chart. Stellar nebula se ya to average star banta hai, phir red giant, planetary nebula aur white dwarf; ya massive star, phir red super giant aur supernova, jo aakhir mein neutron star ya black hole ban jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.5: Star ki life cycle (zindagi ka chakkar) (kitab ki Figure 13.5 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein massive star wale raaste par red super giant ke baad wali stage ka naam 'Positron' chhapa hai. Yeh ghalti hai: yeh stage supernova hai, ek bohat bara explosion (dhamaka), aur drawing mein yahi likha hai. Oopar wala raasta Sun jaise average stars ka hai, neeche wala bhari stars ka; bhari star ka aakhri anjam neutron star ya black hole hota hai.
Neutron stars

Neutron stars universe ki sab se dense (ghani) maloom cheezon mein se hain, black holes ke baad doosre number par. Sab se qareeb wale bhi kai parsec door hain, is liye inhein seedha parhna mushkil hai. Bohat zyada density ki wajah se in ke andar ka matter (maadda) degenerate gas ki tarah behave karta hai, aur in ki taqatwar gravity in ka model banana mushkil karti hai. NASA ke andaze ke mutabiq Milky Way galaxy mein ek billion (arab) tak neutron stars ho sakte hain. Ab tak dekhe gaye bohat se neutron stars relatively (muqable mein) jawan hain, tezi se ghoomte hain aur radiation ki beams (roshni ki lakeerein) bhejte hain; inhein pulsars kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Neutron star jis ka ek hissa kaat kar andar dikhaya gaya hai. Centre se bahar ki taraf safed arrow par neutron degeneracy pressure likha hai, bahar se andar aata arrow gravitational force hai, aur ek pointer bahar ki patli layer (thin atmosphere) dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.6: Neutron star ka section (kata hua hissa) (kitab ki Figure 13.6 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Scientists ka khayal hai ke pulsar ki radiation tab banti hai jab taqatwar magnetic fields matter ko neutron star ke magnetic poles ki taraf le jati hain. Jab star gir kar neutron star banta hai to sirf mass hi nahi dabta, magnetic field bhi bohat taqatwar ho jata hai: core girte waqt field lines ek doosre ke qareeb dab jati hain, aur qareeb lines ka matlab taqatwar field hai.
Hamara star (Sun / Sooraj)

Sun zameen ka sab se qareebi star aur hamare planet ke liye garmi aur roshni ka sab se bara source (zariya) hai. Yeh taqreeban 4.6 billion (arab) saal pehle gas aur dust ke ek bohat bare badal, solar nebula, se bana. Gravity se contract hone par centre ka temperature barha aur protostar bana. Jab core bohat garam ho gaya to nuclear fusion shuru hua jis mein hydrogen helium mein badli aur bohat energy nikli. Sun ki zindagi ki stages: nebula, protostar, main sequence, red giant, planetary nebula aur white dwarf. Is waqt Sun main sequence stage mein hai, hydrogen ko helium mein badal kar garmi aur roshni bana raha hai. Thermal physics mein Sun is liye aham hai ke yeh bohat zyada heat energy ka natural (qudrati) source hai aur yeh energy zyada tar radiation ke zariye pohanchata hai.

blocks.alt: Timeline: Birth aur phir 1 se 14, billion saal (taqreeban) mein. Sun paidaish ke baad ahista ahista garam (gradual warming) hota aur barhta hai; 4 aur 5 ke darmiyan Now ka arrow hai. Taqreeban 10 par red giant, 11 par planetary nebula aur 12 se 14 tak white dwarf. Sizes scale par nahi.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.5: Sun ki life cycle (kitab ki Figure 13.5 ke mutabiq original drawing; kitab yeh number do dafa chhapti hai).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Neeche ke examples mein gravity ke pressure ka mota andaza Pg ≈ GM²/R⁴ se nikal kar star ke andar ke pressure se muqabla kiya gaya hai: Pg zyada ho to star contract hota hai, andar ka pressure zyada ho to expand hota hai, dono barabar hon to star stable hai.

blocks.title: Example 13.3
blocks.problem: Ek star ka mass 2 × 10³⁰ kg aur radius 7 × 10⁸ m hai. Gravitational pressure nikalein aur andar ke pressure 1.0 × 10¹⁴ Pa se muqabla karein.
steps: Pg = (6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²)(2 × 10³⁰ kg)²/(7 × 10⁸ m)⁴
Pg andar ke pressure (1.0 × 10¹⁴ Pa) ka taqreeban 11 guna hai.
blocks.answer: Gravity zyada taqatwar hai, is liye star equilibrium (balance) mein nahi: yeh contract hoga (sukrega).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Example 13.3 mein 6.67 × 4 × 10⁴⁹/2.401 × 10³⁵ ko ≈ 1.3 × 10¹⁴ Pa chhapti hai aur kehti hai ke dono pressures barabar hain, is liye star stable equilibrium mein hai. Sahi division ≈ 1.1 × 10¹⁵ Pa deti hai, jo andar ke pressure ka taqreeban 11 guna hai; is liye gravity jeetti hai aur star contract hota hai.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Neutron star itna dense hai ke us ke matter ke ek teaspoon (chhote chamche) ka mass 5.5 × 10¹² kg se zyada hoga, yani Giza ke Great Pyramid (bara ahram) ke mass ka taqreeban 900 guna. Agar poori zameen ko neutron star ki density tak daba diya jaye to woh sirf 305 m diameter ke gole mein sama jaye.

blocks.title: Example 13.4
blocks.problem: Ek bhari star ka mass 4 × 10³⁰ kg, radius 5 × 10⁸ m aur andar ka pressure 1 × 10¹⁴ Pa hai. Check karein ke star stable hai ya nahi.
blocks.answer: Gravity bohat zyada taqatwar hai, is liye star contract hoga aur aakhir collapse ho sakta hai (shayad neutron star ya black hole ban jaye).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Example 13.4 mein jawab ≈ 1.7 × 10¹⁵ Pa chhapti hai; diye gaye numbers se ≈ 1.7 × 10¹⁶ Pa aata hai. Result wahi hai: gravity zyada hai, star contract hoga.

blocks.title: Example 13.5
blocks.problem: Ek star ka mass 1 × 10³⁰ kg, radius 1 × 10⁹ m aur andar ka pressure 5 × 10¹⁴ Pa hai. Star ki state (halat) batayein.
steps: Andar ka pressure 5 × 10¹⁴ Pa, Pg se taqreeban 7.5 guna zyada hai.
blocks.answer: Andar ka pressure dominant (zyada taqatwar) hai, is liye star expand hoga (phailega) aur red giant ban sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Pg ≈ GM²/R⁴ istemal karte hue samjhayein ke jis star ka andar ka pressure Pg se kam ho woh kyun contract hota hai.
blocks.explanation: Gravity star ko taqreeban Pg ke pressure se andar kheenchti hai. Agar bahar dhakelne wala gas ka pressure is se kam ho to net (kul) force andar ki taraf hai, is liye star contract hota hai. Contract hote hue gas dabti aur garam hoti hai, pressure barhta hai, yahan tak ke balance wapas aa jaye ya core collapse ho jaye.

blocks.text: Short summary (mukhtasar khulasa)

items: Stars nebulae se bante hain; stable star mein gravity aur pressure barabar: ΔP/Δr = −GM_rρ_r/r².
H se He ka fusion star ko chalata hai; phir red giant, aur aakhir white dwarf (kam mass) ya supernova se neutron star/black hole (zyada mass).
Bhari stars sab se kam, red dwarfs sab se zyada jeete hain.
Sun: 4.6 billion saal purana, abhi main sequence mein.
Pg ≈ GM²/R⁴ ko andar ke pressure se mila kar star ka anjam: Pg zyada to contract, kam to expand.
